{{Quote|I do not want my child to grow up knowing war. But I do want my child to know the Republic, and I fear that our current course will not allow for it.|Terrinald Screed|<ref name="HNN47" />}}
'''Terrinald Screed''' was an [[Judicial/Legends|officer]] of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and an early [[Politics/Legends|political]] ally of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. As a young [[Commander/Legends|commander]], Screed broke the [[Biskaran Pirates]]' [[siege of Niele]], losing his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] in the process. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], and, along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], commanded the [[Victory Fleet]] that defeated the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces of [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo]]. Their victory saw Screed promoted to [[Vice Admiral/Legends|vice admiral]] and command of the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]].

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Screed became one of the first [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and acted as one of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] right-hand men. Screed commanded Imperial forces that defeated Separatist holdouts in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and served with distinction in [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Western Reaches Operation|campaign]] in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. His mission to seek out new opportunities for the now Emperor Palpatine in the Outer Rim led him to form alliances with the [[Great Heep]], establishing a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation on [[Biitu]], and with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], in search of the valuable [[Roonstone]]s. Both operations ended in disaster after the intervention of the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Mungo Baobab]] along with his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].

Screed's career declined in the following years, and after Palpatine's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Screed became one of the many [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] fighting for control of the Empire. He eventually aligned himself with the Warlord [[Zsinj]], who later executed him for treason.

==Biography==
===Early service in the Old Republic===
{{Quote|If the Separatists consolidate their military might, then what would we have to protect us? It takes an army to fight an army.|Terrinald Screed|<ref name="HNN47" />}}
[[File:Screed-HNN.png|thumb|left|215px|Screed in 22 BBY]]
Terrinald Screed was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He studied at the [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]] [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Fleet Camp]] and the [[Carida/Legends|Caridan]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|Military Academy]], and after graduating pursued a career as a [[Judicial/Legends|Judicial]] in the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Republic Judicial Department]].<ref name="TEGW" /> Screed achieved the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and, in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], was decorated for leading a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that broke the [[Biskaran Pirates]]' [[siege of Niele]]. During the battle, Screed lost his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] to a Biskaran [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]], leaving him scarred.<ref name="TEGW" /> Screed opted to have an advanced [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacement fitted in place of his missing eye, instead of a more aesthetically-pleasing prosthetic.<ref name="TDRA2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> During his early career, Screed became convinced that the Republic was decaying from within, but discovered a like mind in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], then [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Believing that Palpatine could save [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="DB" /> Screed became one of the senator's early allies.<ref name="NEGC" />

By the end of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], he had become a [[Parent/Legends|father]] to a [[Terrinald Screed's child|child]] and was an established figure in the Republic's Judicial Department, often acting as a spokesman for the body. Screed became increasingly concerned about the growing threat of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], believing that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and various [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] forces were insufficient to protect the Republic, and that a unified military force was needed. Therefore, when the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], proposing the creation of a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], was put before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], Screed became one of its most outspoken supporters, and spoke passionately on the subject to [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN47" /> When the tension between the Republic and the Separatists eventually led to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="DB" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Screed saw the conflict as an opportunity for "house-cleaning" to put an end to the decadence of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="DB" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|I have leaned on Jan in far more dangerous instances than these.|Terrinald Screed, on being supported by Jan Dodonna while receiving the Holt Cross|<ref name="TEGW" />}}
[[File:Screed_and_Dodonna.jpg|thumb|right|190px|Terrinald Screed and Jan Dodonna receive the Holt Cross on Anaxes.]]
During the war, Screed played an active role in the Republic's war effort. By late [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he had been promoted to [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and was given command of one of the two task forces that made up the [[Victory Fleet|first fleet]] of [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers]], the other being commanded by another rising commander, Captain [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]. The Victory Fleet's first assignment was far from a casual shakedown cruise, as they were dispatched to stop a Confederate [[Bulwark Fleet|fleet]] under [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo]], which had recently broken through the Republic's [[Battle of Foerost (Clone Wars)|blockade]] of the [[Foerost Shipyards]] and launched a series of attacks throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. In a campaign that would decide which side controlled the Core Worlds, Screed and Dodonna's fleet clashed with Ningo's forces in battles at [[Battle of Ixtlar (Clone Wars)|Ixtlar]], [[Battle of Alsakan (Clone Wars)|Alsakan]], and [[Battle of Basilisk (Clone Wars)|Basilisk]], before a final [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|confrontation]] above [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. Dodonna took his task force into battle against Ningo, suffering heavy losses but drawing the enemy commander's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] into position for Screed to launch an ambush. Screed's forces emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and launched a broadside fusillade<ref name="NEC" /> against Ningo's [[Unrepentant (Bulwark Mark I)|''Unrepentant'']]. The Confederate [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] was destroyed but the explosion struck the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of Screed's Star Destroyer, the ''[[Arlionne]]'', leaving Screed with near-fatal injuries<ref name="TEGW" /> that required further cybernetic reconstruction.<ref name="NEC" />

Three weeks after the final battle against Ningo, Screed and Dodonna were presented with the [[Holt Cross]] on Anaxes. Still suffering from his injuries, Screed had to be supported by his friend throughout the ceremony.<ref name="TEGW" /> The two subsequently returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as heroes.<ref name="NEC" /> Shortly afterwards, Screed was promoted to [[Vice Admiral/Legends|vice admiral]]<ref name="DFS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 4: Of the Crudest Matter}}</ref> and given command of the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]] by the now [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, with complete authority over the capital world's defenses.<ref name="Insider75">{{InsiderCite|75|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02}}</ref> The assignment also allowed him time to recover from his injuries.<ref name="TEGW" />

===Imperial era===
{{Quote|No man becomes what he despises all at once. It happens little by little, through the smallest betrayals and abandonments. I think Terrinald knew on some level that the New Order he had done so much to support was hollow and built on lies, as I discovered. But his conclusion was different from mine&mdash;Terrinald concluded ''everything'' was built on lies. And in a galaxy like that, a man may as well become a liar himself.|Jan Dodonna|<ref name="TEGW" />}}
With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Separatist leaders shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], the Clone Wars came to an end. In a [[Declaration of a New Order|speech]] shortly after the end of the war, Palpatine announced that the Republic was to be reorganized into a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with him as its [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], and blamed many of the Republic's troubles on the Jedi, who were declared enemies of the Empire.<ref name="SWIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> Screed became one of the first officers appointed to the upper echelons of the new [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="DB" /> Promoted to [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]],<ref name="TEGW" /> he became one of the Emperor's right-hand men,<ref name="TDRA2" /> and was charged with seeking out new opportunities for the Empire in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DB" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Imperial forces stages a [[Ciutric Offensive|major push]] to bring order to the lawless worlds of the Outer Rim. Separatist forces had fled from [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and joined forces with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] in the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]]. Based out of [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], Screed's fleet formed part of [[Tenth Army|Crimson Dagger Command]], which was charged with eliminating this threat. Screed worked closely with [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] during the campaign, and the pair developed a mutual respect while achieving victories in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz]], [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan]], Ciutric, [[Nijune sector/Legends|Nijune]], [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen]] and [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. After Screed's forces defeated the Separatists at the [[Battle of Vinsoth (Imperial Period)|Battle of Vinsoth]], the Muun leadership fled to [[Binquaros]]. Screed left Romodi's ground forces to [[Siege of Binquaros|fight]] the Muun while he pursued a combined [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] and Thalassian fleet to [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]. Screed [[Battle of Bimmiel|eliminated]] the Separatist fleet, but while he was engaged at Bimmiel, pirate and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces driven from the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] by another Imperial task force [[Battle of Botajef (Imperial Period)|overcame]] his rear guard at [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef]]. Joining forces with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] from [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], they broke Romodi's siege and fled to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] with their allies from Binquaros. Acting on intelligence from a [[Unidentified pirate captain (Vardoss)|pirate captain]], Screed and Romodi [[Assault on Vardoss IV|intercepted]] the Separatists at [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss]] and finally defeated them. Screed's victory saw him again celebrated as a hero in the Core Worlds.<ref name="TEGW" />

During the final days of the Clone Wars, the remnants of Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] forces had fled to the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Palpatine tasked [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] with pacifying the region. In response to Tarkin's request for significant military resources, Screed and Admiral [[Bannidge Holt]] were given joint command of the [[Western Reaches Superiority Force|naval forces]], while Romodi was assigned to lead the ground forces. The [[Western Reaches Operation]] captured the imagination of the Imperial citizenry, with battles at [[Ord Vaug system/Legends|Ord Vaug]], [[Halm]], [[Pendaxa]] and [[Ichtor system/Legends|Ichtor]] becoming famous throughout the Empire. After Holt was killed and Romodi injured during an [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirate]] ambush at [[Bryndar]], Screed's forces defeated the pirates at [[Fanha/Legends|Fanha]]. The pirate lord [[Guun Cutlax]] fled to the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]], where he joined forces with the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] general [[Kendu Ultho]], but the Imperials followed and ultimately defeated Ultho's forces at [[Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Ogoth Tiir]].<ref name="TEGW" />

Screed's career peaked with the Western Reaches Operation.<ref name="TEGW" /> The [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] saw the rise of [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] and an increase in [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. For a short time Screed took the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Boc Aseca]] as his manservant, until [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] discovered the slave was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and demanded that Screed hand him over for execution.<ref name="DFS" /> He was also known to have owned at least two more Twi'lek slaves in his lifetime, and recommended the [[Species/Legends|species]] as good slaves in a report on slavery for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] years later.<ref name="Insider89">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref> Screed was regularly invited to appear at fetes in the Core Worlds but rarely spoke in public. Instead, the admiral increasingly spent time on his flagship, the [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Demolisher]]'', devising increasingly-corrupt economic schemes in the Outer Rim to increase his personal wealth.<ref name="TEGW" /> Nevertheless, by [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="15BBY">"[[Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]" in ''[[Polyhedron 170]]'' states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> Screed was still an important figure within the Empire. That year, he traveled to [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]] to represent the Empire at the [[Boonta Speeder Race]], watching [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben's]] victory from a private viewing box.<ref name="ARttF">{{DroidsCite|A Race to the Finish}}</ref>

====Biitu mining operation====
{{Quote|Screed, you incompetent fool!''"<br />"''Me? You lumbering junk heap. If you weren't so wrapped up with your droid harem, none of this would have happened.''"<br />"''Tiny minded Imperial twit!''"<br />"''It was your useless droids that let out the R2 units. You're finished!|The Great Heep and Screed exchange insults as their scheme falls apart|<ref name="TGH">{{DroidsCite|The Great Heep}}</ref>}}
[[File:ScreedHeep.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Screed and the Great Heep]]
At some point, Screed discovered the husk of a giant [[Abominor]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] known only as the [[Great Heep]] at the [[Braltzamir Museum of Antiquated Machinery]]. After a team of students from the [[Imperial Engineers Academy]] found a way to revive the Heep, Screed formed a partnership with the Abominor<ref name="TDRA2" /> to establish a droid-operated [[Mining/Legends|mine]] to exploit a newly discovered source of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Biitu]]. The Empire, however, was not the only interested party, and [[Mungo Baobab]] had traveled to the world to establish his own mining operation for the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]]. While Baobab saw the mine as a source of income for the native [[Biituian]] population, Screed and the Great Heep planned to drive them away from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and seize the planet for the Empire. To this end, Imperial forces, led by the Heep, went to Biitu and constructed the "[[moisture eater]]," a tower that drained all moisture from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], causing a drought that threatened to kill the natives.<ref name="TGH" />

The Imperials soon had control over Biitu and established the mine under the Heep's supervision. Mungo Baobab was captured during the invasion, along with his droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. While Baobab was imprisoned, C-3PO was set to work in the mine and R2-D2 was sent to the Heep's [[droid harem]], along with numerous other [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], which the Heep planned to drain of power in order to recharge himself. Eventually, Screed arrived aboard a cargo [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to take possession of the first shipment of fuel ore. Screed was met by the Great Heep and was taken to Baobab's [[Prison/Legends|cell]] where he informed the prisoner that he would be taking him to the Emperor the following day&mdash;to ensure that his valuable prisoner was not harmed, Screed planned to have him put into hibernation for the journey.<ref name="TGH" />

The following morning, Screed, along with two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and an [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]], went to Baobab's cell to give him the injection that would put him in hibernation for the trip. Unknown to the Imperials, Baobab had acquired a saw from the Biituian [[Fidge Tadrazan]] and had spent the night sawing through one of the cell bars. Screed's arrival initially stopped Baobab from making his escape, but when Tadrazan arrived outside and began throwing rocks at the Imperials, Screed ordered his stormtroopers to capture the young Biituian, and Baobab used the distraction to kick away the weakened bar and escape his cell. Screed pulled his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and fired after Baobab, but both the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and Tadrazan were able to escape down a nearby pipe into the tunnel system below the Imperial installation, sealing the entrance behind them.<ref name="TGH" />

[[File:ScreedVsAngryFarmers-TGH.png|thumb|left|250px|Screed is captured by Biituians.]]
Despite the setback, Screed proceeded with the loading operation. Knowing that Baobab might attempt to get aboard his vessel, the admiral ordered his stormtroopers to watch for Baobab, and to only allow droids aboard the ship. C-3PO, meanwhile, had assisted R2-D2 in escaping from the droid harem and the two rendezvoused with their master. After disguising himself in old droid parts, Baobab and the two droids were able to sneak aboard Screed's ship, posing as part of the loading crew. Baobab's plan was to use the ship against the moisture eater, but as R2-D2 attempted to access the ship's [[Computer/Legends|computer]], the droid activated a silent alarm that alerted Screed to the intruders. Screed returned to his ship with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of stormtroopers to apprehend Baobab but they were delayed at the entrance ramp by an apparently disgruntled droid. Only when the droid's hand fell off, revealing the [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand below, did Screed realize that the droid was Baobab in disguise, attempting to delay them while R2-D2 took control of the ship. As Screed's stormtroopers moved to capture Baobab, R2-D2 succeeded in raising the ship off the ground, leaving both Baobab and C-3PO behind.<ref name="TGH" />

Screed quickly responded to the new threat, ordering his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to man the mine's [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] and shoot down the captured vessel. However, the situation deteriorated further when Tadrazan arrived in a stolen vehicle that he used to disable the turrets. The Biituian was also joined by dozens of astromech droids from the harem, which began [[Skirmish on Biitu (15 BBY)|attacking]] the stormtroopers. Screed was attempting to get the situation under control when the Great Heep arrived. The Abominor blamed the apparent chaos on Screed, who in turn accused the Great Heep of failing to keep control of his droids. However, their bickering was soon ended when R2-D2 opened the ship's cargo doors and dropped its cargo of ore containers, forcing Screed to take cover. Seeing the danger above, the Great Heep attempted desperately to stop the ship before it could destroy the moisture eater, but R2-D2 sent it on a collision course with the tower before abandoning ship. As the cargo ship collided with the tower, Screed could only watch helplessly<ref name="TGH" /> as the stored moisture was released in a torrent of rain that extinguished the Heep's furnace and left the giant droid deactivated.<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> With the Heep gone, Screed and the other Imperials found themselves outnumbered by the natives and were easily rounded up. The Imperials were forced to help restore the destroyed crops, leaving a humiliated Screed to vow revenge on Baobab.<ref name="TGH" />

====Search for the Roonstones====
{{Quote|I look forward to dealing with the Empire.''"<br />"''We shall deal with you, Koong, however we see fit.|Governor Koong invites Screed to Roon|<ref name="TotRC">{{DroidsCite|Tail of the Roon Comets}}</ref>}}
Screed eventually left Biitu and returned to his duties with the Empire. Although the incident on Biitu was disastrous enough to have nearly toppled his career, he nonetheless rebounded from the failure.<ref name="TDRA2" /> While searching for new opportunities for Imperial expansion, Screed dispatched a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] to the distant [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|Cloak of the Sith]] region to look for planets ripe for conquest. When the droid returned to the ''Demolisher'', it brought a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] message from [[Bisad Koong]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Tawntoom]] province on the planet [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. In his message, Koong explained that he was seeking an alliance with the Empire. Though Screed viewed Koong's proposal with disdain, the governor's gift of a valuable [[Roonstone]], the source of which was of great interest to Palpatine, was enough to convince the admiral to meet with him.<ref name="TotRC" />

[[File:ScreedStarship-TotRC.png|thumb|right|250px|Admiral Screed's flagship, the ''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer ''Demolisher'']]
After arriving in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Screed took a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] to Koong's [[new Umboo Lightstation]] to meet with the governor. He was surprised to learn that Koong had already received what he believed to be the Imperial emissaries&mdash;Screed's old adversary Mungo Baobab, along with the droids C-3PO and R2-D2. Baobab had arrived earlier, seeking to establish the first trade route between the Empire and the [[Roon system/Legends|Roon system]], only to be mistaken for an Imperial representative by Koong. His true identity revealed, Baobab attempted to flee, but was soon caught by Koong's aide [[Gaff]] while Screed's stormtrooper guards captured the droids. Screed was pleased to once more have Baobab in custody and had him locked in one of Koong's cells. The admiral had need of C-3PO's services and ordered the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] reprogrammed, while R2-D2 would be turned over to Koong.<ref name="TotRC" />

With the intruders caught, Koong began to show Screed around the [[lightstation]]. The governor had had the original lighstation shut down and was using his lightstation to cause unsuspecting ships to crash in order to scavenge their cargo&mdash;a process that Screed saw as little more than piracy. Their negotiations were cut short by a sudden explosion&mdash;Baobab and the droids were attempting to escape with the assistance of fellow prisoner [[Noop Yeldarb]] and several crates of [[Nergon-14/Legends|Nergon-14]] had exploded in the ensuing chaos, damaging the ship's engines. As the lightstation began to drift into the nearby [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], Koong ordered an evacuation. Screed led the Imperials aboard Baobab's ship, the ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]'', joined by Koong and Gaff, escaping shortly before the lightstation was destroyed. Baobab was also able to escape, stealing Koong's personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Screed was not impressed by the incident and ordered his stormtroopers to lock Koong and Gaff in the ship's brig.<ref name="TotRC" />

====Alliance with Koong====
{{Quote|The Emperor would enjoy these games&hellip;provided that he always won.|Terrinald Screed, while watching the Roon Colonial Games|<ref name="TRG">{{DroidsCite|The Roon Games}}</ref>}}
Koong's protests that only he could lead Screed to the source of the Roonstones initially fell on deaf ears,<ref name="TotRC" /> but the admiral's desire to acquire the Roonstones ultimately led him to give Koong another chance. In exchange for providing the Empire with the precious gems, Screed promised Koong an alliance and access to Imperial resources including stormtroopers and a Star Destroyer. In truth, however, the admiral had no intention of making an alliance and only sought the Roonstones to present to the Emperor.<ref name="TFC">{{DroidsCite|The Frozen Citadel}}</ref> Proceeding to Roon, Koong attempted to show Screed that his world had more to offer than just the Roonstones. Screed was unconvinced but agreed to accompany the Tawntoom governor to the [[Roon Colonial Games]] after hearing that Koong's forces had intercepted and destroyed Baobab's ship. If Tawntoom's team could defeat the [[Umboo Racing Team|team]] from [[Umboo]] at the games, the governor expected the last province resisting his rule to lose morale and fall under his control.<ref name="TRG" />

[[File:ScreedKoong-TRG.png|thumb|left|250px|Screed and Governor Koong watch the Roon Colonial Games.]]
Screed watched the Roon Colonial Games from Koong's private box, but was shocked to see Baobab arrive with Umboo's champion [[Drainsweeper/Legends|Drainsweeper]] team. Seeing that the admiral's patience was waning, Koong ordered Gaff to ensure that Baobab and the Umboo team were eliminated before the final, and deciding, event of the games. Gaff's efforts met with mixed success&mdash;the Umboo Drainsweeper riders [[Gee Long]] and [[BIX]] were incapacitated before the race, but Baobab was able to survive an attempt to eliminate him. After Baobab and C-3PO agreed to join [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]] in place of the missing riders, the Umboo team was once again able to win the Drainsweeper event, and take overall victory in the games. With Koong's plans once more foiled by Baobab, Screed was not willing to tolerate any further delays and demanded that the governor deliver the promised Roonstones to him.<ref name="TRG" />

However, Koong was unable to deliver on his promise, having failed to locate the source of the Roonstones. Knowing that his only hope was for Baobab to lead him to the Roonstones, Koong dispatched probe droids to locate the merchant. Koong's efforts eventually paid off, and Screed was watching the surveillance feed with the governor when Auren and [[Nilz Yomm]] arrived at Baobab's vessel. Baobab had also been unable to locate the source of the Roonstones and was preparing to leave, but when his visitors presented him with one, saying that it had come from an old prospector known as "[[Oggem Baobab|Old Ogger]]," he decided to pay the hermit a visit. Koong promptly dispatched Gaff to follow Baobab, and Screed ordered his stormtroopers to assist the [[Kobok/Legends|Kobok]], reminding the governor that any Roonstones he found were the property of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="AtRS">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref>

"Old Ogger" was able to give Baobab a lead and the merchant headed for the port of [[Nime]], along with Auren Yomm and the droids. There Koong's forces apprehended the group and took them to the governor's ship for the journey across the [[Roon Sea]] to [[Koong Island]], where Screed was waiting to take them to Tawntoom for interrogation. The admiral eventually received word from Koong that the prisoners had escaped en route, and though Koong begged another chance, Screed made it clear that his report to the Emperor would indicate his displeasure.<ref name="AtRS" />

====Showdown with Baobab====
{{Quote|The Roonstones. They're all here, and they're all&mdash;''"<br />"''Mine! Commander, impound this fortress. It is now Imperial property.''"<br />"''But, my treasure!''"<br />"''The Emperor's treasure, Koong. Did you really think we'd form an alliance with a petty tyrant such as you?|Koong is betrayed by Screed|<ref name="TFC" />}}
[[File:ScreedRooze-TFC.png|thumb|right|250px|Screed and Gaff after a rooze leak]]
Other than the Roonstones, the only thing on Roon that was of interest to Screed was the wealthy Umboo province that still resisted Koong's control. The increasingly desperate Koong planned a show of force to impress Screed and the two departed for Umboo aboard one of Koong's ships. Koong's plan was to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] Umboo's population by releasing the deadly [[Rooze Disease|rooze germ]] over the province. Screed, however, saw the plan as foolhardy&mdash;the Empire's previous use of rooze had caused as many deaths among its own forces as the enemy. The admiral's concerns were proved well-founded when a leak in the rooze containers allowed the deadly germ to enter circulation on Koong's ship. While Screed's stormtroopers were protected by their [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]], the admiral used a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] to keep from breathing the germ. Koong, however, was not so fortunate and was infected by the germ as he attempted to shut down the ventilation system.<ref name="TFC" />

Koong's only hope of survival was to enlist the help of the Nilz Yomm in finding a cure, and Screed allowed his stormtroopers to accompany Gaff in capturing the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]. They returned with both Nilz and Auren, but Screed's patience was exhausted and he informed the ailing governor that he would be withdrawing his forces from Roon that afternoon. Meanwhile, Mungo Baobab traced his captured friends to Koong's [[Fortress of Tawntoom]], built atop a volcano in an otherwise frozen wasteland, and mounted a rescue effort. During the rescue, Baobab discovered that the volcano itself was the source of the Roonstones he and Screed had sought. The admiral was leading his troops aboard their shuttle as the stricken Koong made one final attempt to persuade him to stay, when Gaff arrived in pursuit of Baobab and the escaping Yomms. Screed's stormtroopers moved to attack Baobab but were stopped by Koong when the governor saw that Baobab carried the cure for his illness. While the Yomms attempted to start the engines on Baobab's captured ''Caravel'', the merchant proposed a deal to the Imperials&mdash;he would provide both the cure and the source of the Roonstones in exchange for safe passage and peace with Umboo. Upon discovering that the Roonstones were in the surrounding volcano, Screed turned on Koong, declaring the fortress Imperial property and ordering his troops to impound it.<ref name="TFC" />

Seeing Screed's betrayal, Koong used the drilling [[Laser/Legends|laser]] to blast the surrounding Roonstones free from the rock, sending them plummeting into the [[Magma/Legends|lava]] below in an effort to keep them out of the admiral's hands. However, the Roonstones caused the lava to freeze, depriving the fortress of its only source of heat and leaving it vulnerable to the harsh climate. With the situation having once more turned against him, Screed ordered his troops to their shuttle and evacuated the fortress before it froze. Baobab's ship was also able to escape, but Koong succumbed to his disease shortly before the fortress froze around him.<ref name="TFC" />

===Later career===
{{Quote|I always had a soft spot for that old hawk-bat.|Gilad Pellaeon, to Arien Yage|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>}}
In the years following the debacle on Roon, Screed's position in the Imperial hierarchy faltered, with him falling behind the various moffs and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]] in the Emperor's favor, though he continued to serve as an admiral in the Imperial Navy.<ref name="DB" /> A few months after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]<ref name="Insider89" /> at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Screed was working with the Imperial Security Bureau on Imperial Center.<ref name="Insider89" />

[[File:Admiral_Screed_MoM.png|thumb|left|270px|Terrinald Screed]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Emperor set a trap for the Rebel Alliance, using his presence aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] while it underwent construction over the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] as bait.<ref name="NEC" /> Screed was among the Imperial commanders who participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TDRA2" /> However, the battle went against the Empire; the Death Star was destroyed and Emperor Palpatine was killed.<ref name="NEC" /> After the Emperor's death, Screed became one of many [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] who used the subsequent power vacuum to attempt to carve a personal empire out of former [[Imperial Space]],<ref name="DB" /> ultimately allying himself with Warlord [[Zsinj]],<ref name="TDRA2" /> one of the most powerful Imperial warlords.<ref name="NEC" /> However, when Zsinj learned that Screed had been in contact with his old friend, Imperial Navy Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], he had Screed executed for [[Treason/Legends|treason]]<ref name="TDRA2" /> at some point prior to Zsinj's own death in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="8ABY" />

Years later, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong Invasion]], now Grand Admiral Pellaeon asked if Screed was still serving in the Empire. Pellaeon's aide, [[Arien Yage]], reminded him that Screed had been executed by Zsinj, and Pellaeon reminisced that he had always been fond of the "old [[Hawk-bat/Legends|Hawk-bat]]."<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It does not surprise me that the one area worth having on this planet is the one area you cannot take! The Empire has no use for weak allies!|Terrinald Screed, to Governor Koong|<ref name="TFC" />}}
[[File:ScreedFinger-TRG.png|thumb|right|250px|Screed lifting a finger at the incompetent Governor Koong]]
Terrinald Screed was an easily recognizable figure due to his above average height, angular features and the electronic [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] he wore in place of his left eye.<ref name="DB" /> Disciplined and composed,<ref name="TDRA2" /> Screed was an accomplished military commander with a talent for [[Space warfare/Legends|space combat]].<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> Screed saw success in campaigns for both the Galactic Republic and Galactic Empire and was decorated for his actions on multiple occasions. His bravery came at a high personal cost, with the loss of his eye during his early career and near-fatal injuries sustained at the Battle of Anaxes during the Clone Wars.<ref name="TEGW" /> Screed cared little for how he appeared to others, and preferred an advanced cybernetic replacement for his eye over a less noticeable prosthetic.<ref name="TDRA2" />

During his time as a Judicial, Screed respected the Jedi and their long-standing duty to protect the Republic. However, he felt that times had changed, the Jedi were no longer sufficient, and that a stronger force was needed. Motivated in part by his desire to see his child grow up in a strong Republic,<ref name="HNN47" /> Screed became a strong [[Militarists/Legends|Militarist]] and campaigned publicly for the Military Creation Act.<ref name="TEGW" /> Screed was also a loyal officer of the Judicial Department&mdash;when Captain [[Zozridor Slayke]] and the crew of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Scarlet Thranta]]'' defected from the Republic to begin a private war against the Separatists shortly before the Clone Wars, Screed spoke out against their vigilante actions, even though he understood their motivations.<ref name="HNN54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|regional/1352_4.html|Vigilante Taskforce Departs to Engage Separatists}}</ref> Screed went on to keep the public informed of his department's efforts to reign in the vigilantes,<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|jediwatch/1359_1.html|Jedi Taskforce Dispatched to Reel in Thranta}}</ref><ref name="HNN56">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|regional/13516_3.html|Sluis Van Offer Met with Doubt}}</ref> though there were suggestions that they privately supported the renegades' actions, and may have even helped orchestrate them.<ref name="HNN55" />

Eventually he came to see the Republic as ineffective and hypocritical,<ref name="Insider89" /> and by the rise of the Empire, Screed was a firm believer in the New Order and its tenets, regarding non-Humans as inferior<ref name="DFS" /> and devoting much of his time to devising schemes to increase his own wealth.<ref name="TEGW" /> By this time he was a no-nonsense military man<ref name="AGSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' {{C|"Admiral Screed"}}</ref> and had little tolerance for either those who opposed the Empire or those who failed him. Governor Koong in particular was frequently on the receiving end of the admiral's disappointment.<ref name="TotRC" /><ref name="TRG" /><ref name="AtRS" /><ref name="TFC" /> Screed could also be overconfident; during the Imperial occupation of Biitu, Screed dismissed the threat posed by the natives, only to suffer a humiliating defeat when they revolted against him.<ref name="TDRA2" /> During his later career, the once eloquent and outspoken admiral became almost reclusive, rarely speaking in public<ref name="TEGW" /> and known for his short temper and occasionally eccentric behavior.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I wanted to give Screed a backstory that made him sympathetic and even sad, instead of being (literally) a cartoon villain.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>}}
Admiral Screed was created as the primary Imperial antagonist of the [[Nelvana]] cartoon series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]''. Screed first appeared briefly in "[[A Race to the Finish]]," the fourth and final episode of the first story arc,<ref name="ARttF" /> which was written by [[Peter Sauder]] and [[Steven Wright]] and first broadcast on [[September 28]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> The character returned to play a larger role in the last four episodes of the series, along with the two-part special "[[The Great Heep]]."<ref name="TGH" /><ref name="TotRC" /><ref name="TFC" /><ref name="TRG" /><ref name="AtRS" /> In all these appearances, Screed was voiced by [[Graeme Campbell]].<ref name="TGH" /> Screed's first name was not revealed until the character appeared in a series of articles on [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] prior to the release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] in [[2002]]. The articles touched on the character's life prior to the events of ''Droids'',<ref name="HNN47" /> as did ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' ([[2005]]).<ref name="NEC" /> ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' ([[2012]]) further expanded the character's history with a detailed biography.<ref name="TEGW" /> Author [[Jason Fry]] attempted to make Screed a more sympathetic, less one-dimensional character than in ''Droids''.<ref name="Endnotes" />

''The New Essential Chronology'' established that Screed was a captain at the time of the Battle of Anaxes.<ref name="NEC" /> ''[[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:3:02]]'' in [[Star Wars Insider 75|''Star Wars Insider'' 75]], set shortly afterwards, refers to him as an admiral, yet ''[[The Dark Forces Saga]]'' calls him a vice admiral at the time he owned Boc after the Clone Wars. Therefore, it is assumed that his promotion during the Clone Wars was only to vice admiral, with his full promotion to admiral coming at some point prior to the ''Star Wars: Droids'' cartoons.<ref name="DFS" /><ref name="Insider75" />

The origin of Screed's electronic eye patch was unclear until the release of ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="TEGW" /> ''The New Essential Chronology'' established that Screed underwent cybernetic surgery following the Battle of Anaxes,<ref name="NEC" /> but [[Joe Corroney]]'s illustration of Screed for ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47]]'' depicted him with an eye patch before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.<ref name="HNN47" /> ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', which also expands Screed's early Imperial career, confirms that the eye patch was as the result of an injury sustained prior to the Clone Wars.<ref name="TEGW" /> The nature of Screed's subsequent cybernetic reconstruction during the Clone Wars is unknown.<ref name="NEC" /> Screed's right eye, which is not covered by the eye patch, appears brown in Corroney's illustration,<ref name="HNN47" /> yet has a bluish appearance in the character's depiction in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].<ref name="SWR" />

Authors [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]] mentioned Screed in ''[[The Droids Re-Animated]]'', an article that was released on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] in [[2013]].<ref name="TDRA2" /> The article had been written years prior,<ref name="Sonko lives">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50797043|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-06-15|time=2:57 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316143709/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958/#post-50797043}}</ref> and it had originally established Screed as losing his eye during the "subjugation of [[Ord Gertoth]]." Peña and Handley removed the detail, however, following the publication of ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="subjugation">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50863647|board=Literature|thread=What's This? More Droids from Handley and Peña?|user=Halagad_Ventor|date=2013-07-15|time=1:59 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180316144023/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-pe%C3%B1a.50012958/page-4#post-50863647}}</ref>

[[Tim Veekhoven]], in developing the StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for [[Tzizvvt]] as part of ''[[What's The Story?]]'', established the character as a suspect in the theft of valuable relics from Biitu and Roon.<ref name="DB-Tzizvvt">{{DB|character|tzizvvt|Tzizvvt}}</ref> Veekhoven initially used Screed as the owner of the stolen objects, but this did not make the final entry.<ref name="Blog-teekay-421|13">{{Blog|teekay-421|13|They were the chosen ones}}</ref>

A Screed action figure was intended to be released as part of the second wave of [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Star Wars: Droids (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] range. However, the line was canceled before the second wave entered production and only around a dozen prototypes of the Screed figure were ever made.<ref name="Kenner">{{SWArchive|url=vault/collecting/droids_ewoks_25th_anniversary/index.html|text=25 Years of Collecting ''Droids'' and ''Ewoks''!}}</ref> Admiral Screed was one of the random names used by [[Wikipedia:Artificial intelligence in video games|computer-controlled]] Imperial players in the [[2001]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
